title: The Galaxy S26 and S26 Plus are more of the same for more money
summary: The S26 Plus (left) and S26 (right) are mostly software updates. There's a cool new hardware feature debuting at Samsung's annual Unpacked event - but you won't find it on the Galaxy S26 or S26 Plus. contentText:
The S26 Plus (left) and S26 (right) are mostly software updates.

Don't get me wrong, some of those software updates are pretty neat. You can apply Audio Eraser to third-party apps to make voices easier to hear and filter out background noise. Google's Gemini AI will start doing agentic things - like booking an Uber for you - which is a step toward fulfilling the promise of an assistant that actually assists. …
